use_case_summary: Real-time chat for mobile/social games: short-turn conversational UI in lobbies, player-to-player messaging with system assistant for onboarding tips. Must include automated abuse/spam detection, keyword-based routing, and low-latency streaming responses for typing indicator UX.
requirements_summary: Latency: median <120-150ms for single-turn messages under normal load; concurrency target ~200-500 concurrent chat users in first month. Throughput: estimate 8-12k messages/day after launch. Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, needs predictability — prefers per-message pricing with quota alerts. Security: audit logs, SSO later, retention controls. Model: open to curated small/medium models if latency/cost tradeoff is favorable. Fallbacks: wants simple fallback to cheaper model for non-critical system messages.
